readWith: text layer, with the collided rows read from the page

symptoms.symptom: Detergent residue is present in the detergent dispenser or the tab collecting tray.

causes.label: Detergent dispenser was damp when detergent was added.
remedies: Only add detergent to the detergent dispenser when dry.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Detergent dispenser was damp when detergent was added."

symptoms.symptom: Connection to home network is not established.

causes.label: WLAN on router is not active.
remedies: Check the wireless network connection of your router.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "WLAN on router is not active."

symptoms.symptom: Special salt refill indicator lights up.

causes.label: Sensor does not detect special salt tablets.
remedies: Do not use special salt tablets.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Sensor does not detect special salt tablets."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for special salt does not light up.

causes.label: Water softening system is switched off.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Water softening system is switched off."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid lights up.

causes.label: No rinse aid.
remedies: Set the amount of rinse aid to be dispensed.

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid does not light up.

causes.label: Rinse aid system is switched off.
remedies: Set the amount of rinse aid.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Rinse aid system is switched off."

causes.label: Hand soap got in the rinse aid dispenser.
remedies: Immediately add rinse aid to the dispenser.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Hand soap got in the rinse aid dispenser."

causes.label: Rinse aid has been spilled.
remedies: Remove the rinse aid with a cloth.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Rinse aid has been spilled."

causes.label: Detergent or machine care product used causes excessive foaming.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Detergent or machine care product used causes excessive foaming."

causes.label: Connection to home network is not available.
remedies: Activate the wireless network connection on your router.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Connection to home network is not available."

symptoms.symptom: Home Connect cannot be implemented correctly.

causes.label: Home Connect set incorrectly.
remedies: Please consult the documents supplied for Home Connect®.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "Home Connect set incorrectly."

causes.label: There is a technical error.
remedies: Please consult the information on support in the documents supplied for Home Connect®.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 45: "There is a technical error."
